title: Love Dining Hotels Terms and Conditions
review_note: All 35 pages reviewed. Current baseline only: prior bytes were not retained, so no historical diff is claimed. The page 6 versus page 11 description of 1864 remains a documented source ambiguity.

clauses.title: Eligibility and savings ladder
clauses.summary: An eligible Singapore-issued physical Card is required. Savings are 15% for 1 adult, 50% for 2, 35% or 33% for 3, 25% for 4, and 20% for 5–10 during 2026.

clauses.title: Copthorne, Fairmont and Frasers outlet scope
clauses.summary: The matrix defines qualifying buffet or à la carte scope for Princess Terrace, Tien Court, Connections, The Eight, Prego, Asian Market Cafe, ANTI:DOTE and LUCE, including fixed 35% or High Tea exceptions.

clauses.title: Grand Copthorne outlet scope
clauses.summary: Food Capital covers buffet; Riverside Terrace and Lobby Lounge require one à la carte food item per diner; SanSara requires one à la carte main.

clauses.title: M Hotel, Orchard, Pan Pacific and Paradox scope
clauses.summary: The matrix defines buffet or à la carte scope for M Hotel, Orchard Hotel, Mosella, Ellenborough Market Cafe and Blue Potato, including Hua Ting’s fixed 35% benefit.

clauses.title: Paradox, Pullman, RWS and Marriott scope
clauses.summary: Crossroads Bar has fixed 20%; Madison’s, MOGA, CHIFA!, Soi Social and Marriott outlets have named menu scope. The PDF listing of CHIFA! is not treated as current eligibility evidence.

clauses.title: Marriott, Sofitel and Swissôtel scope
clauses.summary: Wan Hao, Racines, 1864, Kopi Tiam, SKAI Restaurant, SKAI Bar and Stamford Brasserie have named menu or fixed-rate scope. The 1864 benefit basis conflicts with page 11 and remains flagged.

clauses.title: Swissôtel, Capitol and Fullerton scope
clauses.summary: The matrix defines CLOVE, TWG Tea, Capitol hotel outlet and Town Restaurant menu or buffet scope.

clauses.title: Fullerton and St. Regis scope
clauses.summary: Sophia, Yan Ting and The Tea Room have named menu scope and exclusions; Yan Ting requires two mains and excludes specified weekend service and dim sum brunch.

clauses.title: St. Regis and W Sentosa scope
clauses.summary: St. Regis Bar, SKIRT, the kitchen table and WOOBAR have named food scope and minimum orders; selected W brunch or buffet services have distinct conditions.

clauses.title: W Afternoon Tea
clauses.summary: W Afternoon Tea is available daily from 3–5pm and requires one set per diner; savings apply to the total food bill.

clauses.title: Minimum orders and special rates
clauses.summary: Named groups require one main or buffet per diner. Third-party bookings are excluded; specified outlets use fixed 20% or 35% rates, and order shortfalls reduce savings to 15%.

clauses.title: Visit scope, exclusions and billing
clauses.summary: Savings normally apply at lunch and dinner. Sets, promotions, non-food charges, private dining and takeaway are excluded; parties above 10, bill splitting and multiple cards do not qualify.

clauses.title: Copthorne policies
clauses.summary: Copthorne applies holiday and occasion blackouts plus hotel events. Princess Terrace and Tien Court or Connections use distinct child age and communal-counting rules.

clauses.title: Fairmont policies
clauses.summary: Fairmont has outlet-specific blackout treatment, a Monday 50% offer for up to five adults, possible Prego seating allocations, advance booking and detailed buffet or à la carte child-counting.

clauses.title: Frasers House and Man Fu Yuan policies
clauses.summary: Frasers outlets have holiday and occasion blackouts; Man Fu Yuan also excludes 15 CNY days and specified premium dishes, weekend dim sum buffet, sets, seasonal and promotional menus.

clauses.title: Frasers Lobby Lounge, booking and children
clauses.summary: Lobby Lounge has named all-day and afternoon-tea scope and exclusions. All Frasers outlets require one-day advance booking; LUCE and other outlets use distinct child-counting rules.

clauses.title: Grand Copthorne policies
clauses.summary: Grand Copthorne applies holiday, occasion and hotel-event blackouts. Food Capital and the à la carte outlets use distinct child age and communal-counting rules.

clauses.title: JW Marriott policies
clauses.summary: Akira Back has named menu exclusions; Beach Road Kitchen covers buffet. Both require two-day booking, exclude third-party bookings, may limit allocations, and apply outlet-specific child rules.

clauses.title: M Hotel policies
clauses.summary: Café 2000 and The Buffet Restaurant qualify for lunch or dinner buffet. Holiday, occasion and hotel-event blackouts apply; ages 7–12 on child pricing do not count and ages 13+ count.

clauses.title: Orchard Hotel policies
clauses.summary: Orchard Café covers buffet; Hua Ting has fixed 35% with exclusions; Bar Intermezzo requires a main. Additional CNY blackouts and outlet-specific child-counting apply.

clauses.title: Pan Pacific Orchard policies
clauses.summary: Mosella requires one à la carte main per diner. Holiday and occasion blackouts apply; children below 7 do not count and ages 7–12 use communal counting.

clauses.title: Paradox Singapore policies
clauses.summary: Ellenborough covers buffet, Blue Potato requires a main, and Crossroads Bar has fixed 20% for up to 10. Blackouts and distinct buffet versus à la carte child-counting apply.

clauses.title: Pullman Hill Street policies
clauses.summary: Madison’s and MOGA have day, meal and menu limits; Monday has a selected-item 50% offer for up to four adults. Blackouts and communal child-counting apply; MOGA is adult-only after 6pm.

clauses.title: Resorts World Sentosa policies
clauses.summary: The PDF lists CHIFA! and Soi Social menu scope, requires official advance booking with AmexLD, excludes third-party bookings, and applies blackouts and child rules. It does not override the dated CHIFA closure listing.

clauses.title: Singapore Marriott outlet scope
clauses.summary: Crossroads Café, Crossroads Buffet, Wan Hao and Lobby Lounge have named buffet, menu-category or item-level scope and exclusions.

clauses.title: Singapore Marriott blackouts and children
clauses.summary: Standard and Wan Hao CNY blackouts apply. À la carte and buffet outlets use distinct child age, free-dining and qualifying-main rules.

clauses.title: Sofitel City Centre policies
clauses.summary: Racines and 1864 have named category and minimum-order scope. Holiday and occasion blackouts apply; children below 7 do not count and ages 7–12 use communal counting.

clauses.title: Swissôtel outlet scope
clauses.summary: SKAI Restaurant, CLOVE and TWG Tea have named menu or buffet scope and exclusions; TWG has bounded booking hours, and SKAI Bar uses fixed 20%.

clauses.title: Swissôtel operating policies
clauses.summary: Monday offers 50% at participating outlets except TWG for up to five adults. SKAI may limit allocations and requires advance booking; Swissôtel and TWG use distinct child-counting rules.

clauses.title: Capitol Kempinski policies
clauses.summary: 15 Stamford, Capitol Bistro, Lobby Lounge and The Bar have named menus and minimum orders. Standard blackouts and communal child-counting apply.

clauses.title: Fullerton Hotel policies
clauses.summary: Town Restaurant qualifies for weekday lunch and selected dinner buffets. Holiday, occasion, Easter, F1 and Thanksgiving blackouts apply; ages 6–11 on child pricing do not count.

clauses.title: St. Regis outlet scope
clauses.summary: Sophia, Yan Ting and The Tea Room have named category, minimum-order, set-lunch or weekend exclusions; Sophia’s non-alcoholic Sunday brunch qualifies.

clauses.title: St. Regis policies
clauses.summary: St. Regis Bar requires two food items. General and Yan Ting CNY blackouts apply; ages 4 and below do not count and ages 5–12 use communal counting.

clauses.title: W Sentosa outlet scope
clauses.summary: SKIRT, the kitchen table and WOOBAR have named à la carte, brunch, buffet or beverage scope. Sunday brunch has fixed 15% for up to 10 people.

clauses.title: W Sentosa booking, blackout and children
clauses.summary: WET Deck has fixed 15% food savings. W outlets require 48-hour booking with AmexLD, apply specified blackouts and child rules, and state that the document was current when updated in Aug 2026.
